rules.name: rrr-qc-trades-cfs
rules.sql: SELECT TRIM(t.trade_id) AS trade_id, t.contract_number, t.transaction_date, t.deal_status, t.netting_status, t.original_lots, s.security_id, s.derivative_type, s.maturity_date FROM dbsystemuat.cloned_deal_ticket_table_cfs t JOIN dbsystemuat.cloned_security_info_table_cfs s ON s.security_id = t.security_id WHERE s.security_id LIKE 'CM QC %' AND t.transaction_date <= :valueDate AND (s.maturity_date IS NULL OR s.maturity_date >= :fromDate)

SELECT trim(t.trade_id) AS trade_id, t.contract_number, t.transaction_date, t.deal_status, t.netting_status, t.original_lots, s.security_id, s.derivative_type, s.maturity_date FROM opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table t JOIN opera.cloned_security_info_table s ON s.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND s.business_unit = t.business_unit AND s.security_id = t.security_id WHERE t.tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = 'CFS' LIMIT 1) AND t.business_unit = 'CFS' AND s.security_id LIKE 'CM QC %' AND t.transaction_date <= :valueDate AND (s.maturity_date IS NULL OR s.maturity_date >= :fromDate)
